waivers.reason: Both reports are separate GND pour islands on one layer that each hold a via to the opposite-layer GND plane; the return current flows through the plane via those vias. Checker treats the layer fill as one trunk and reports neck 0. 0.7 A is a conservative return-current model; real GND current here is well under 0.5 A.
